passportRide.title: Add this ride to a visit
passportRide.description: Record your ride on {{attraction}} in the draft visit you choose.
passportRide.unverified: The known operating dates are not enough to verify this ride. You can still record it.

empty.title: No draft visit for this park
empty.description: Create a visit for {{park}}, or open your passport to consciously reopen a completed visit. No ride will be created without a visit.

visit.legend: Which visit should receive this ride?
visit.hint: Only your draft visits for this park are offered. Your choice is always explicit.

fields.timeUnavailable: Add an exact day and a time zone to the visit before entering a time.
fields.rating: Optional private rating for this ride
fields.ratingHint: From 0.5 to 5 in half-point steps. This private rating does not affect community rankings.
fields.groupedRatingHint: For several rides, add them in one batch, then rate each entry from the visit.

conflict.title: The known dates do not match
conflict.description: {{attraction}} appears incompatible with the visit on {{visitDate}}. Confirm only if this memory is accurate.
conflict.confirm: I confirm that I took this ride despite the date mismatch.

actions.createVisit: Create a visit for this park

rideAndRating.few: {{count}} rides and their private rating were recorded for {{attraction}}.
rideAndRating.many: {{count}} rides and their private rating were recorded for {{attraction}}.
rideAndRating.other: {{count}} rides and their private rating were recorded for {{attraction}}.

ratingFailed.few: The {{count}} rides were recorded, but their optional rating could not be saved. You can add it from the visit.
ratingFailed.many: The {{count}} rides were recorded, but their optional rating could not be saved. You can add it from the visit.
ratingFailed.other: The {{count}} rides were recorded, but their optional rating could not be saved. You can add it from the visit.

errors.loadTitle: Your visits could not be loaded
errors.loadVisits: Your draft visits for this park could not be loaded.
errors.loadMoreVisits: The next visits could not be loaded. Try again.
errors.evaluate: This attraction could not be checked against the selected visit.

errors.confirmConflict: Explicitly confirm the date mismatch before saving.
errors.rating: Choose a rating from 0.5 to 5 in half-point steps, or leave the ride unrated.
errors.multipleRating: The direct rating applies to one ride. For several rides, save the batch and then rate each entry from the visit.
errors.invalid: Check the ride count, outcome and time.
errors.response: The server did not return the expected ride. Open the visit before trying again.
errors.visitNoLongerDraft: This visit is no longer a draft. Choose another one or reopen it from your passport.
errors.network: The server response did not arrive. Try again: the same operation will not create a duplicate.
